title: Orsen and the Autopsy
author: August Joubert
blurb: Casper Nystrom, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
